about: B21: the built-in texts of the page wizard (original plain text, English and Bangla). slots.<slot> holds the texts of a recipe slot; pages.<page type>.<slot> replaces them for one page type; '<slot>:<product source>' is used for product sections (chosen, category, best_sellers, new_arrivals). Each language holds a list of variants with the same fields; one is picked from the page title. Placeholders: {store} (the store's name), {title} (the page title), {category} (the first chosen category). Fields: heading, text, button (+ button_link), title, subtitle, element_text, cta_title, cta_text, cta_button (+ cta_link). No prices, discounts, stock or delivery promises.
